product_overview: Wolfie Delivery is a New York City food delivery customer app for browsing restaurants, customizing food orders, checking out, and tracking delivery in real time. The customer experience also includes account access and basic profile management within a single frontend application.
core_goals: Browse restaurants and discover menu items by search and filtering
View restaurant details and choose items to order
Customize food items and manage the cart before checkout
Complete checkout by entering delivery and payment details
Track orders in real time with live status and driver location updates
Access the account through login and registration

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allow customers to register, log in, and enter the app with saved session support.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter account details -> Submit registration form -> Verify OTP -> Enter address details -> See home screen
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> See home screen
Open the app with a stored session -> See home screen

features.name: Restaurant Browsing and Discovery
features.description: Help customers explore restaurants, search for dishes, and open restaurant details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse the restaurant list -> Filter restaurants by category -> Search for a dish or restaurant -> Open a restaurant detail view
Navigate to / -> Browse the restaurant list -> Open a restaurant detail view

features.name: Food Customization and Cart Management
features.description: Let customers customize menu items, add them to the cart, and adjust cart contents before checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a restaurant detail view -> Choose a food item -> Select spicy level -> Toggle toppings and additions -> Add item to cart -> See the item in the cart
Navigate to / -> Open a restaurant detail view -> Choose a food item -> Customize the item -> Add item to cart -> Open the cart -> Edit item quantities -> See updated cart total

features.name: Checkout and Order Placement
features.description: Enable customers to review their order, enter delivery and payment details, and place the order.
user_flows: Open the cart -> Proceed to checkout -> Enter delivery details -> Add a new credit card -> Review the order total -> Place the order -> See the order confirmation
Open the cart -> Proceed to checkout -> Enter delivery details -> Select a saved payment card -> Review the order total -> Place the order -> See the order confirmation

features.name: Live Order Tracking
features.description: Show customers real-time order progress, driver movement, and chat access during delivery.
user_flows: Open the order tracking view -> Watch the order status update in real time -> View the live driver location on the map -> Expand order details -> See delivery progress
Open the order tracking view -> Open courier chat -> Send a message to the courier -> Continue tracking the order on the map

features.name: Profile and Settings
features.description: Let customers update saved account and delivery information used for future orders.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open settings -> Update delivery address -> Save changes -> See the updated address reflected in the account
Navigate to / -> Open settings -> Update dietary preferences and allergies -> Save changes -> See the updated preferences in the account

routes.description: Main application layout switcher (home, restaurant, detail, cart, checkout, tracking, chat, settings)
User Login View within page switcher
User Registration View within page switcher

features.name: Restaurant Exploration
features.description: Explore restaurants, view dish categories, search dishes, and filter by criteria.
user_interactions: Click category button to filter restaurants
Type search query to search dishes
Click restaurant card to view details

features.name: Food Item Customization & Cart
features.description: Customize food item options (size, spicy, toppings) and add to cart.
user_interactions: Click cart icon to edit quantities or checkout

features.name: Payment & Checkout
features.description: Add payment card, select delivery address, and complete order checkout.

features.name: Geolocation Live Tracking
features.description: Track orders in real-time with status stepper and live Mapbox map coordinates.
user_interactions: View live driver marker updates on map
Click chat icon to talk to courier
